patches.title: Clean Object Transport
patches.principle: After cleaning, move directly to the target destination and place the object without pausing elsewhere.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned an object and need to place it.

patches.title: Countertop Exhaustion
patches.principle: Search all countertops in ascending numeric order before checking any other furniture or containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and you are on a countertop.

patches.title: Sink Only for Cleaning
patches.principle: Only use the sinkbasin to clean objects; do not attempt to clean at other locations.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have a dirty object and need to clean it.
